title: Wedding Package Dispute
question_for_arbitration: Claimant Sophia Bennett, the cardholder, challenges Hana Luxvita Weddings LLC’s right to retain a $3,000 credit-card charge made on January 15, 2026 for the Hana Luxvita Signature Wedding Package. Claimant acknowledges that she authorized the transaction and does not allege fraud or unauthorized use. Claimant contends, however, that Hana Luxvita did not provide the contracted level of planning and coordination services, including adequate timeline management, vendor coordination, planning consolidation, and continuity of coordination. Claimant therefore disputes the merchant’s entitlement to retain the full $3,000 charge and seeks return of the portion of the charge, if any, that the arbitrator determines is not supported by the services actually provided. Respondent disputes that a material service deficiency occurred and maintains that the charge was authorized and that substantial contracted services were performed.
arbitration_clause: This arbitration shall be administered by DecisionLayer.AI under its Foundational + Strict Contractual Ruleset, subject to the law of New York and the Federal Arbitration Act. The arbitration will be held online through DecisionLayer.ai.
